<file path="source.py">
from typing import Type, TypeVar, Generic
T = TypeVar('T')

class ValidatedSetting:
    setting_type = setting_type
    default = default
    -_name = None
    -_name = f"_{name}"
    __init__(self, setting_type: Type[T], default: T)
    __set_name__(self, owner, name)
    __get__(self, instance, owner) -> T
    __set__(self, instance, value: T)

class SingletonMeta(type):
    -_instances = {}
    __call__(cls)

class AppConfig:
    timeout = ValidatedSetting(int, 30)
    retries = ValidatedSetting(int, 3)
    api_key = ValidatedSetting(str, "")
    -_temp_settings = {}
    timeout = 45
    -_temp_settings = {
            'timeout': self.timeout,
            'retries': self.retries,
            'api_key': self.api_key
        }
    timeout = self._temp_settings['timeout']
    retries = self._temp_settings['retries']
    api_key = self._temp_settings['api_key']
    -_temp_settings = {}
    __init__(self)
    load_from_remote(self, url: str) -> None
    __enter__(self)
    __exit__(self, exc_type, exc_val, exc_tb)
</file>
